title: 2007 AMC 12B Problem 2
statement: A college student drove his compact car \(120\) miles home for the weekend and averaged \(30\) miles per gallon. On the return trip the student drove his parents’ SUV and averaged only \(20\) miles per gallon. What was the average gas mileage, in miles per gallon, for the round trip?

solutions.text:
The trip home uses \(\frac{120}{30}=4\) gallons, and the return trip uses \(\frac{120}{20}=6\) gallons.

The round trip covers \(240\) miles on \(10\) gallons, so the average is \[ \dfrac{240}{10}=24. \]

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: Average mileage is total miles divided by total gallons, not the average of the two rates
The car uses \(\frac{120}{30}\) gallons and the SUV uses \(\frac{120}{20}\) gallons
